objective: Diagnosticar en solo lectura por que R30 no pudo materializar un snapshot atomico de ORIGEN MPRO 2026-10-02. Comparar exactamente los conteos/totales del encabezado contra los fallbacks resumidos abiertos, cerrados canonicos y cerrados provisionales de la misma API local. No tocar Produccion.

queries.name: origen_header_open_exact
queries.sql: SELECT ISNULL(SUM(ticket.ventas),0) AS ventas_abiertas, COUNT(*) AS tickets_abiertos, ISNULL(SUM(ticket.pax),0) AS pax_abiertos FROM (SELECT c.Co_Folio, SUM(ISNULL(cd.Cd_Importe,0)) AS ventas, MAX(ISNULL(c.Co_Personas,0)) AS pax FROM Comanda c INNER JOIN Comanda_Detalle cd ON cd.Co_Folio=c.Co_Folio WHERE CAST(c.Co_Fecha AS date)='2026-10-02' AND c.Sc_Cve_Sucursal='0023' AND c.Es_Cve_Estado IN ('AC','IM') AND cd.Es_Cve_Estado='AC' AND cd.Fecha_Baja IS NULL GROUP BY c.Co_Folio) ticket

queries.name: origen_fallback_open_folios
queries.sql: SELECT c.Co_Folio AS folio, MAX(c.Es_Cve_Estado) AS estado, MAX(ISNULL(c.Co_Personas,0)) AS pax, SUM(ISNULL(d.Cd_Importe,0)) AS total_ticket FROM Comanda c INNER JOIN Comanda_Detalle d ON d.Co_Folio=c.Co_Folio AND d.Es_Cve_Estado='AC' AND d.Fecha_Baja IS NULL WHERE CAST(c.Co_Fecha AS date)='2026-10-02' AND c.Sc_Cve_Sucursal='0023' AND c.Es_Cve_Estado IN ('AC','IM') GROUP BY c.Co_Folio ORDER BY c.Co_Folio

queries.name: origen_header_closed_canonical_exact
queries.sql: SELECT ISNULL(SUM(vc.venta_neta),0) AS ventas_cerradas_dia, COUNT(DISTINCT vc.Vn_Documento) AS tickets_cerrados_dia FROM (SELECT ve.Vn_Documento, SUM(ISNULL(ve.Vn_Precio_Neto_Importe,0)) AS venta_neta FROM Venta_Encabezado ve WHERE ve.Sc_Cve_Sucursal='0023' AND CAST(ve.Vn_Fecha AS date)='2026-10-02' AND ve.Es_Cve_Estado IN ('AC','FA') AND ve.Fecha_Baja IS NULL GROUP BY ve.Vn_Documento) vc

queries.name: origen_fallback_closed_canonical_folios
queries.sql: SELECT ve.Vn_Documento AS folio, SUM(ISNULL(ve.Vn_Precio_Neto_Importe,0)) AS total_ticket, COUNT(*) AS headers FROM Venta_Encabezado ve WHERE CAST(ve.Vn_Fecha AS date)='2026-10-02' AND ve.Sc_Cve_Sucursal='0023' AND ve.Es_Cve_Estado IN ('AC','FA') AND ve.Fecha_Baja IS NULL GROUP BY ve.Vn_Documento ORDER BY ve.Vn_Documento

queries.name: origen_header_closed_provisional_exact
queries.sql: SELECT ISNULL(SUM(ticket.ventas),0) AS ventas_cerradas_dia, COUNT(*) AS tickets_cerrados_dia, ISNULL(SUM(ticket.pax),0) AS pax_cerrados_dia FROM (SELECT c.Co_Folio, SUM(ISNULL(cd.Cd_Importe,0)) AS ventas, MAX(ISNULL(c.Co_Personas,0)) AS pax FROM Comanda c INNER JOIN Comanda_Detalle cd ON cd.Co_Folio=c.Co_Folio WHERE CAST(c.Co_Fecha AS date)='2026-10-02' AND c.Sc_Cve_Sucursal='0023' AND c.Es_Cve_Estado='PA' AND cd.Es_Cve_Estado='AC' AND cd.Fecha_Baja IS NULL GROUP BY c.Co_Folio) ticket

queries.name: origen_fallback_closed_provisional_folios
queries.sql: SELECT c.Co_Folio AS folio, MAX(ISNULL(c.Co_Personas,0)) AS pax, SUM(ISNULL(d.Cd_Importe,0)) AS total_ticket FROM Comanda c INNER JOIN Comanda_Detalle d ON d.Co_Folio=c.Co_Folio AND d.Es_Cve_Estado='AC' AND d.Fecha_Baja IS NULL WHERE CAST(c.Co_Fecha AS date)='2026-10-02' AND c.Sc_Cve_Sucursal='0023' AND c.Es_Cve_Estado='PA' GROUP BY c.Co_Folio ORDER BY c.Co_Folio
